en: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;In order to arrange things▼just right, you really need▼to use your imagination!

en: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;Sometimes I wonder if he has▼ever picked up a dictionary in▼his life!

en: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;I need to gain more wisdom,▼power, and courage by the time▼I'm a grownup.

en: $024'327'4;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'383;but the courage quandary has▼stumped me.

en: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;You get a chance to see▼a side of them that you've▼never seen before.

en: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;Best friends are connected by▼a bond, they're like family!

en: $024'327'7;$023'327'177'10'1;Tell me if I'm overthinking▼this one...

en: $024'327'6;$023'327'8'10'1;$022'327'382;Guys are usually thought of▼as being pretty easygoing.

en: $024'327'2;$023'327'28'8'4;$022'327'381;I've always forgiven my friends▼for being late...but this is▼getting out of hand...

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;True friendship is when you▼can tell your friend he's stupid▼and he doesn't get angry!
